description: This Java test source file contains unit tests for the RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler class within the OpenMRS project. It verifies that the handler correctly enforces that void reasons are provided when voiding entities such as Patient, Encounter, and PersonAddress.

classes.name: RequiredReasonVoidSaveHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit Jupiter test class for testing the behavior of RequireVoidReasonSaveHandler when handling void operations.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfPatientVoidReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that an APIException is thrown if a Patient entity is voided without a void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfEncounterVoidReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that an APIException is thrown if an Encounter entity is voided with an empty string as the void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowAPIExceptionIfObsVoidReasonIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that an APIException is thrown if an Encounter entity is voided with a blank ( whitespace) void reason.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNotBlank
methods.description: Verifies that no exception is thrown when a void reason is provided for an Encounter entity.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNullForUnsupportedTypes
methods.description: Ensures that for entity types not explicitly enforced (e.g., PersonAddress), null void reasons do not cause exceptions.
